_comment: Rects are [x, y, width, height] in points of the reference's viewport (CSS px = iPad pt), scaled to the image; width "100%" spans the viewport. Keys are desktop surface ids (surfaces.mjs) without the NN prefix; skin variants use their surface's key. Mascot frames and the focused field's caret are masked per capture from the reference's DOM dump (diff-ipad.py), so they are not listed here.

rects.why: desktop: the macOS hiddenInset title bar strip (traffic lights at 16,16 are drawn by macOS, the renderer reserves the 36 pt band); iPad: the iPadOS status bar. The iPad draws no fake title bar and keeps the band as its top inset.
